capabilities: Publish the current note and its embedded images to a private GitHub repository
Generate a stable UUID in note properties and write the public link back to the note
Unpublish a note by deleting its folder from the repository
Copy the published public link to the clipboard
disambiguation: Not a blog or full-site publisher; it shares individual notes via UUID links.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README documents its exact network usage and states the GitHub token is stored locally in the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to share a single note publicly without sending its content to a third-party publishing service.

relations.evidence: Using your fine-grained GitHub token, it commits the document as <root>/<uuid>/index.md
The worker that turns <uuid> into a readable page is deployed by you.

requires.name: GitHub account with a private repository
Fine-grained GitHub Personal Access Token (Contents: Read and write)
Deployed worker (Cloudflare or self-hosted) that renders the public pages

summary: Publishes a single note with its embedded images to your private GitHub repo and shares it via a UUID-only link served by a self-hosted worker.
